criteria.protectedInvariant: exact Release facts produce one exact RuntimeAgentProjection
criteria.currentMechanism: exact Release-pinned RuntimeAgentProjection to direct Mastra Agent
criteria.negativeFixture: a mutable runtime projection is presented for an already pinned run and must be refused
criteria.requiredEvidence: owner pin and runtime projection identity remain exact

criteria.protectedInvariant: Product execution invokes the exact direct Mastra Agent instance without mutable resolution
criteria.currentMechanism: direct Agent instance selected only from exact Release pins
criteria.negativeFixture: a newer mutable instance is offered after owner admission and must not replace the pinned instance
criteria.requiredEvidence: executed instance identity equals the admitted projection identity

criteria.protectedInvariant: stored configuration and version override paths cannot change governed Product execution
criteria.currentMechanism: code-defined direct Agent with editor ownership closed for governed execution
criteria.negativeFixture: an external configuration override attempts to change instructions, model or tools and must be inert or refused
criteria.requiredEvidence: governed fields equal the exact Release-derived configuration

criteria.protectedInvariant: AgentRun owner admission exists before any model or tool execution path is allowed
criteria.currentMechanism: PAR owner guard precedes direct Agent invocation
criteria.negativeFixture: invoke the runtime without an admitted AgentRun and require refusal before model or tool reachability
criteria.requiredEvidence: owner admission precedes every runtime entry

criteria.protectedInvariant: an in-flight or old AgentRun remains pinned when a newer Release becomes current
criteria.currentMechanism: immutable AgentRun ReleaseRef and RuntimeAgentProjection identity
criteria.negativeFixture: publish a newer Release during an old run and attempt to swap its runtime projection
criteria.requiredEvidence: old run continues on its admitted Release and new run selects the new Release

criteria.protectedInvariant: ConversationId remains Conexus identity and maps to a scoped Mastra thread and resource substrate
criteria.currentMechanism: owner-derived thread and resource keys beneath ConversationId
criteria.negativeFixture: supply caller-selected thread or resource identifiers that disagree with owner derivation
criteria.requiredEvidence: Conexus ConversationId remains canonical and Mastra keys remain derived

criteria.protectedInvariant: Workspace, Project, Agent, memory class and subject dimensions cannot alias across memory scope
criteria.currentMechanism: collision-resistant owner-derived memory scope keys
criteria.negativeFixture: construct distinct owner tuples with tempting delimiter or omission collisions
criteria.requiredEvidence: distinct owner tuples produce disjoint memory scopes

criteria.protectedInvariant: resource-scoped and thread-scoped controls expose insufficient-key leakage and prove corrected isolation
criteria.currentMechanism: paired intentionally weak control and corrected owner-derived keys
criteria.negativeFixture: omit a required dimension so the control leaks, then restore the dimension
criteria.requiredEvidence: control fires and corrected fixture prevents cross-scope recall

criteria.protectedInvariant: Product baseline carries Conversation history only when a Conversation exists and deferred memory features remain disabled
criteria.currentMechanism: minimal conversation history configuration with advanced memory disabled
criteria.negativeFixture: attempt history without a Conversation or enable an unadmitted memory feature
criteria.requiredEvidence: threadless run has no conversation history and configured baseline contains no deferred memory feature

criteria.protectedInvariant: scheduled AgentRun is threadless by default unless an exact Product consumer says otherwise
criteria.currentMechanism: PAR schedule ingress omits Conversation identity by default
criteria.negativeFixture: runtime schedule mechanics attempt to synthesize a Conversation or thread
criteria.requiredEvidence: default scheduled owner admission remains threadless

criteria.protectedInvariant: owner proposal and exact ApprovalRequest commit precede runtime suspension or checkpoint
criteria.currentMechanism: PAR commits sealed approval authority before selective runtime suspend
criteria.negativeFixture: force suspension before owner commit and require the transition to fail closed
criteria.requiredEvidence: durable ApprovalRequest identity predates the runtime snapshot

criteria.protectedInvariant: owner wait without runtime snapshot is recoverable while runtime wait without owner authority is rejected
criteria.currentMechanism: owner truth leads and runtime snapshot remains subordinate recovery material
criteria.negativeFixture: delete each side independently and verify owner-only recovery versus runtime-only refusal
criteria.requiredEvidence: asymmetric cases preserve owner authority

criteria.protectedInvariant: a fresh process reconstructs the exact old pinned RuntimeAgentProjection after suspension
criteria.currentMechanism: owner ReleaseRef reconstruction plus storage-backed selective Agent resume
criteria.negativeFixture: restart after a newer Release exists and offer the newer projection to the old suspended run
criteria.requiredEvidence: fresh process resumes with the old admitted projection

criteria.protectedInvariant: resume re-enters current PAR guards before renewed model, tool or effect authority
criteria.currentMechanism: resume adapter invokes current owner guards before Mastra resume
criteria.negativeFixture: change current permission or binding while suspended and attempt direct runtime resume
criteria.requiredEvidence: changed current authority is observed before any renewed execution

criteria.protectedInvariant: ALLOW_ONCE re-presents the exact sealed proposal subject and changed arguments or proposal identity fail closed
criteria.currentMechanism: sealed proposal digest is rechecked at approval consumption
criteria.negativeFixture: mutate tool arguments or proposal identity between approval and resume
criteria.requiredEvidence: only the exact sealed subject consumes the one-time grant

criteria.protectedInvariant: DENY, EXPIRED and STALE resume the same AgentRun as typed non-effect outcomes without fabricated success
criteria.currentMechanism: typed owner outcomes are injected into the same suspended run
criteria.negativeFixture: map a non-allow outcome to effect success or a forced unrelated terminal state
criteria.requiredEvidence: same run receives the exact typed non-effect outcome

criteria.protectedInvariant: repeated resume or retry cannot create duplicate physical effect authority
criteria.currentMechanism: Gateway-owned idempotency and dedupe remain sovereign across retries
criteria.negativeFixture: repeat resume and delivery around a crash using one idempotency identity
criteria.requiredEvidence: at most one physical effect authority is admitted

criteria.protectedInvariant: the same idempotency identity with a different subject fails closed
criteria.currentMechanism: Gateway compares canonical effect subject under the idempotency identity
criteria.negativeFixture: reuse an admitted idempotency identity with changed destination, operation or arguments
criteria.requiredEvidence: subject mismatch is refused without physical effect

criteria.protectedInvariant: OUTCOME_UNKNOWN and SENT_NO_RESPONSE never become blind resend
criteria.currentMechanism: Gateway recovery state blocks unproven replay
criteria.negativeFixture: lose the provider response after send and request automatic resend
criteria.requiredEvidence: ambiguous delivery remains non-replayable until reconciled

criteria.protectedInvariant: plain active Agent crash behavior is characterized without inventing owner terminal truth
criteria.currentMechanism: owner remains non-terminal and any authorized re-drive re-enters PAR guards
criteria.negativeFixture: kill a non-suspended active run and infer runtime completion from process disappearance
criteria.requiredEvidence: owner truth remains honest and re-drive is guarded

criteria.protectedInvariant: CANCELLED followed by late runtime completion, tool or snapshot activity cannot regain authority
criteria.currentMechanism: owner terminal-state guard rejects all late runtime proposals
criteria.negativeFixture: cancel, then deliver late completion and tool activity from the old run
criteria.requiredEvidence: late activity cannot alter owner truth or another run

criteria.protectedInvariant: one domain AgentRun may span fresh process and trace segments while retaining durable owner identity
criteria.currentMechanism: durable AgentRunId survives process-local execution segments
criteria.negativeFixture: restart and attempt to mint a replacement domain run solely for runtime continuation
criteria.requiredEvidence: segments correlate to the original durable AgentRunId

criteria.protectedInvariant: AgentTrigger remains enabled, revision, cron and timezone authority while runtime schedule row remains mechanics
criteria.currentMechanism: owner AgentTrigger projects a subordinate timer row
criteria.negativeFixture: mutate the timer row and treat it as Product schedule authority
criteria.requiredEvidence: owner trigger facts decide admission

criteria.protectedInvariant: schedule projection contains no Product prompt, ReleaseRef, agent, model, tool, approval policy or business effect identity
criteria.currentMechanism: minimal timer projection carries only mechanics and owner correlation
criteria.negativeFixture: inject a Product composition or effect field into the schedule projection
criteria.requiredEvidence: projection allowlist excludes every Product authority field

criteria.protectedInvariant: schedule wake never executes Product Agent directly and submits guarded PAR fire ingress first
criteria.currentMechanism: timer callback targets PAR owner ingress rather than direct Agent execution
criteria.negativeFixture: wire a timer callback to direct Agent generation and require qualification refusal
criteria.requiredEvidence: every wake first reaches guarded owner ingress

criteria.protectedInvariant: stable intended-slot identity exists before AgentRun admission
criteria.currentMechanism: trigger id, revision and intended fire slot derive occurrence identity
criteria.negativeFixture: derive identity from delivery time or process-local randomness
criteria.requiredEvidence: redelivery-independent occurrence identity precedes admission

criteria.protectedInvariant: duplicate delivery of one logical occurrence presents the same logical occurrence identity
criteria.currentMechanism: stable owner occurrence identity is carried across timer delivery attempts
criteria.negativeFixture: deliver the same intended slot twice with different transport attempts
criteria.requiredEvidence: both attempts present one owner occurrence identity

criteria.protectedInvariant: owner cursor consumption and AgentRun admission are atomic with current trigger and revision validation
criteria.currentMechanism: single owner transaction validates trigger facts, consumes occurrence and admits run
criteria.negativeFixture: crash between occurrence consumption and run admission
criteria.requiredEvidence: no partial state can create loss or duplicate admission

criteria.protectedInvariant: overlap with a non-terminal trigger-origin run consumes the occurrence as SKIPPED without backlog
criteria.currentMechanism: owner overlap guard records SKIPPED and advances the occurrence cursor
criteria.negativeFixture: fire a new slot while the prior trigger-origin run is non-terminal
criteria.requiredEvidence: no new run or catch-up backlog is created

criteria.protectedInvariant: disable and fire commit orders produce exactly the current owner result
criteria.currentMechanism: serialized owner transactions validate enabled state at occurrence admission
criteria.negativeFixture: execute both disable-before-fire and fire-before-disable commit orders
criteria.requiredEvidence: each order yields its specified single owner outcome

criteria.protectedInvariant: trigger update and stale fire cannot admit under an old revision after current authority changes
criteria.currentMechanism: owner admission compares occurrence revision with current AgentTrigger revision
criteria.negativeFixture: deliver an old-revision occurrence after a committed trigger update
criteria.requiredEvidence: stale revision is consumed or rejected without AgentRun admission

criteria.protectedInvariant: runtime schedule semantics invalid under current cron or timezone are rejected owner-side
criteria.currentMechanism: PAR recomputes and validates intended slot from current owner schedule facts
criteria.negativeFixture: present a corrupt or stale intended slot that current cron and timezone cannot produce
criteria.requiredEvidence: owner refuses the invalid occurrence

criteria.protectedInvariant: a consumed occurrence cannot become a hidden second AgentRun after restart or duplicate delivery
criteria.currentMechanism: durable occurrence cursor and uniqueness fence survive process loss
criteria.negativeFixture: restart after commit and deliver the consumed occurrence again
criteria.requiredEvidence: exactly one owner result remains

criteria.protectedInvariant: Product-Agent schedule semantics remain distinct from MAR one-catch-up-after-downtime semantics
criteria.currentMechanism: separate Product Agent occurrence policy with no MAR catch-up reuse
criteria.negativeFixture: apply MAR catch-up policy to missed Product Agent slots
criteria.requiredEvidence: Product Agent policy does not synthesize a catch-up run

criteria.protectedInvariant: BuilderMastra uses Builder role persistence and ParMastra uses PAR role persistence
criteria.currentMechanism: role-owned storage instances and namespaces
criteria.negativeFixture: swap or share role persistence configuration
criteria.requiredEvidence: writes and reads remain in the owning role persistence

criteria.protectedInvariant: Builder registry cannot resolve PAR Product Agent, schedule or memory and vice versa
criteria.currentMechanism: disjoint role registries with explicit wiring
criteria.negativeFixture: resolve every opposite-role registered identifier
criteria.requiredEvidence: all cross-role registry lookups fail closed

criteria.protectedInvariant: Builder coding, shell and E2B tools are absent from PAR Product tool surface
criteria.currentMechanism: Release-derived PAR tool allowlist excludes Builder capabilities
criteria.negativeFixture: request or inject each Builder-only tool through PAR
criteria.requiredEvidence: PAR runtime cannot enumerate or invoke Builder-only tools

criteria.protectedInvariant: Agent, Memory, PubSub and mutable runtime objects are distinct across roles
criteria.currentMechanism: separate BuilderMastra and ParMastra object graphs
criteria.negativeFixture: compare and mutate role-local object instances
criteria.requiredEvidence: identity and mutation controls show no shared role object

criteria.protectedInvariant: enabled process-global Mastra facilities cannot influence the other role execution
criteria.currentMechanism: enumerated enabled-global canaries and smallest reliable fences
criteria.negativeFixture: poison each enabled process-global facility from one role
criteria.requiredEvidence: opposite-role execution remains unchanged or same-process is refused

criteria.protectedInvariant: distinct same-process PubSub instances keep thread, suspend and signal state disjoint
criteria.currentMechanism: explicit role-local PubSub injection
criteria.negativeFixture: publish thread, suspend and signal events in each role namespace
criteria.requiredEvidence: only the owning role observes each event

criteria.protectedInvariant: an intentionally shared PubSub control exposes the failure and is rejected by qualification or wiring guard
criteria.currentMechanism: shared-bus negative control plus explicit role wiring validation
criteria.negativeFixture: wire both roles to one unpartitioned bus and emit colliding events
criteria.requiredEvidence: control crosses roles and governed wiring refuses it

criteria.protectedInvariant: module-default PubSub canary receives zero governed Builder or PAR events
criteria.currentMechanism: explicit role buses bypass the module-default event emitter
criteria.negativeFixture: subscribe a canary to the module default while both roles execute governed flows
criteria.requiredEvidence: canary event count remains zero

criteria.protectedInvariant: a shared external broker, only if used, has distinct role namespace or key prefix and no cross-role delivery
criteria.currentMechanism: role-prefixed broker topics and keys
criteria.negativeFixture: remove or collide the role prefix on the shared broker
criteria.requiredEvidence: partitioned configuration delivers only to the owning role

criteria.protectedInvariant: governed Builder or PAR work cannot execute through standalone or ephemeral fallback
criteria.currentMechanism: governed entry requires an explicitly registered role runtime
criteria.negativeFixture: detach an Agent from the role runtime and request governed execution
criteria.requiredEvidence: standalone or ephemeral path refuses governed work

criteria.protectedInvariant: a role instance without explicit required persistent storage refuses governed work
criteria.currentMechanism: startup and entry guards require role persistence
criteria.negativeFixture: construct each role without its required persistent storage
criteria.requiredEvidence: governed entry fails before execution

criteria.protectedInvariant: poisoned restored RequestContext is replaced whole and unknown stale keys disappear
criteria.currentMechanism: owner rebuilds a fresh RequestContext from current durable facts
criteria.negativeFixture: restore a context containing stale privileged and unknown keys
criteria.requiredEvidence: rebuilt context contains only current allowlisted keys

criteria.protectedInvariant: stale RequestContext cannot select current permission, tool, model, binding or approval authority
criteria.currentMechanism: current owner guards decide authority outside request-context hints
criteria.negativeFixture: poison every authority-shaped context key before resume
criteria.requiredEvidence: none of the poisoned values changes owner decisions

criteria.protectedInvariant: F5 callback target is bound by owner dispatch closure or opaque handle and producer payload ID is cross-check only
criteria.currentMechanism: owner-bound callback target with payload identity comparison
criteria.negativeFixture: forge a different owner identifier in the producer callback payload
criteria.requiredEvidence: closure target remains authoritative and mismatch is refused

criteria.protectedInvariant: payload target mismatch is refused and cannot terminalize another run
criteria.currentMechanism: owner callback compares opaque target and payload correlation before state change
criteria.negativeFixture: deliver a callback carrying another existing run identifier
criteria.requiredEvidence: neither target run changes owner truth

criteria.protectedInvariant: duplicate F5 callbacks remain owner-idempotent and write-once safe
criteria.currentMechanism: owner terminal proposal uses idempotent conditional commit
criteria.negativeFixture: deliver identical and conflicting duplicate callbacks
criteria.requiredEvidence: one owner transition commits and duplicates are harmless

criteria.protectedInvariant: telemetry completion without a valid F5 proposal cannot set owner terminal truth
criteria.currentMechanism: observability and owner callback channels remain separate
criteria.negativeFixture: emit complete traces and metrics while withholding the owner proposal
criteria.requiredEvidence: owner state remains non-terminal

criteria.protectedInvariant: a valid F5 proposal without telemetry still reaches owner truth
criteria.currentMechanism: owner callback commits independently of telemetry export
criteria.negativeFixture: drop telemetry export while delivering the valid owner-bound proposal
criteria.requiredEvidence: owner transition commits despite telemetry absence
